hypothesis: Instruction count is approximately fixed overhead plus linear costs in row count, existing token count, and padded tensor size.

pcvs.name: row_count
pcvs.rationale: Captures per-row traversal and tensor conversion overhead.

pcvs.name: token_count
pcvs.rationale: Captures work reading and converting existing token IDs.

pcvs.expression: len(output_token_ids) * max((len(row) for row in output_token_ids), default=0)
pcvs.name: padded_elements
pcvs.rationale: Captures rectangular tensor allocation, padding, and initialization work.
